language.label: Interface language
language.hint: Saved to your account and used on your other devices too.

theme.label: Theme
theme.hint: Applies at once and is saved to your account, so it follows you to other devices.

profile.heading: Profile
profile.name: Display name
profile.nameHint: Shown instead of your user name. Leave empty to use the user name.
profile.hidden: Hide my account from public user lists
profile.hiddenHint: Apps that list accounts on their sign-in screen will not show you.

password.heading: Change password
password.hint: After the change every device, including this one, is signed out.
password.rule: At least {min} bytes; nothing is trimmed.
password.tooShort: The new password must be at least {min} bytes long.
password.tooLong: The new password must be at most {max} bytes long.
password.wrongCurrent: The current password is not correct.
password.changed: Password changed. Sign in again with the new password.

dataRights.title: Your data
dataRights.exportHint: A file (NDJSON) with your account, settings, playback progress and history, watch statistics, signed-in devices, application passwords and shares you created. Passwords, codes and other secrets are never included. The download is recorded in the audit log.
dataRights.deleteWarning: This deletes your account and all its data for good: playback progress and history, statistics, devices, application passwords and shares. It cannot be undone and an administrator cannot restore it.
dataRights.deleteHint: Download your data first if you want to keep it. Enter your password to confirm.
dataRights.acknowledge: I understand that my account and data cannot be recovered.
dataRights.acknowledgeRequired: Confirm that you understand the deletion cannot be undone.
dataRights.confirmPrompt: Delete your account and all its data now?
